===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Intel Atom]] C3558 @2.2GHz (Quad-Core) *Memory: 16GB DDR4 ECC (SODIMM) RAM *Storage: 16MB (SPI Serial) Flash [[Winbond]]), :8GB (NAND eMMC 5.1), 120GB (M.2 SSD) *Network: 6x Gigabit Ethernet ports *PCIe: 1x M.2 (M-Key) slots (used by SSD) *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V, 5A via barrel
